data.body:
Implementation pushed for review: Gerrit change 1366 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1366), commit 34c3ac4940, rebar-ticket trailer + DCO sign-off.

Delivered (test-only; no production behaviour change — sole non-test edit is a decision comment at probe.RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES):
- tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_cloud_rate_limit_sweep_heldout.py: enumerated per-member 429 sweep. Every mutating Cloud transport member classified across two axes (transport seam x dispatch level) with a per-member duplicate-write assessment (the AC repo-artifact table lives in the module docstring). Asserted at each member's OWN 429 boundary: pooled-REST + bare-urlopen -> exactly ONE attempt; subprocess-seam -> bounded Retry-After backoff via _run_acli; dispatch-wrapped (_call_with_retry) -> bounded Retry-After-honouring retry; non-retrying dispatch_apply_phases -> one attempt. Plus AC2 completeness (runs the Step-0 git-grep enumeration, asserts every returned name is classified-mutating or marked non-mutating) and a DC cross-check.
- tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_cloud_config_validation.py: absence-documents that Cloud does NOT reject a non-https url (JiraConfig has no __post_init__) and that _build_jira_backend builds a transport with missing credentials without failing loudly. DC contrast anchors included.
- tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_cloud_user_search_degradation.py: pins that a DC-shaped transport exposing none of _USER_SEARCH_METHODS degrades to the assignable-search string match rather than raising; Cloud-shaped contrast anchor exercises the user-search path.

Item 3 (probe resolved-status): DECIDED a runtime config hook IS warranted for Cloud<->DC parity (Cloud hardcodes RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES; DC reads reconciler.resolved_statuses). Recorded as a repo-artifact comment at probe.RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES citing this ticket + follow-up story e34a-1d0c-0daa-4f2c.

Follow-up tickets filed (discovered_from 2127): bug bdb8-0646-9e13-4bfb (non-https url not rejected), bug ad85-e5e3-be8d-4be5 (missing-credential silent), story e34a-1d0c-0daa-4f2c (probe resolved-status hook).

Mutation-check evidence (concrete manual perturbation -> run module -> revert):
- M1 REST-seam (make _rest_urlopen_with_retry retry HTTPError): RED 9 failed/1 passed (bare-urlopen unaffected) -> GREEN 10 passed.
- M2 subprocess-seam (cap _run_acli _MAX_ATTEMPTS=1): RED 9 failed -> GREEN 9 passed.
- M3 dispatch-wrapped (ignore Retry-After in _call_with_retry): RED 1 failed/1 passed -> GREEN 2 passed.
- M4 non-retrying apply-phase (2nd set_reporter call under 429): RED 1 failed -> GREEN 2 passed.
- M5 non-https absence-doc inverse (add scheme rejection to JiraConfig): RED 1 failed/3 deselected -> GREEN 1 passed.
- M6 missing-cred absence-doc inverse (add fail-loudly guard to _build_jira_backend): RED 1 failed/3 deselected -> GREEN 1 passed.
- M7 user-search degradation (add user-search alias to DC stub): RED 3 failed/2 passed -> GREEN 5 passed.

Gates green: make lint, make typecheck (mypy src/rebar, 429 files), and the three new test modules (34 passed). Awaiting Gerrit LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 before Submit + close.
